title: Compact 3D U-Net for Multi-Region Brain Tumor Segmentation on BraTS 2021 under a 6 GB Memory Budget
description: 3D U-Net model for multi-region brain tumor segmentation (WT / TC / ET) on the BraTS 2021 dataset, trained and evaluated under a 6 GB GPU memory budget. Achieves a native-space Dice Similarity Coefficient of 0.8076. This repository includes the preprocessing, training, and native-space evaluation scripts required to reproduce the reported results.
